changelog:
- Initial release of the `oo-europe-pmc` skill for working with Europe PMC through the OOMOL-connected `oo` CLI.
- Supports literature and preprint search with Europe PMC’s official query syntax and cursor pagination.
- Adds retrieval workflows for publication details, full-text XML, references, citations, data links, and evaluations.
- Includes text-mining and annotation queries by article, entity, provider, relationship, section, or type.
- Covers grant search and publication status checks for updates such as publication, versioning, withdrawal, removal, and retraction.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@d6fb756`
summary: Europe PMC (europepmc.org). Use this skill for ANY Europe PMC request — searching and reading data. Whenever a task involves Europe PMC, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
